reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #600 '[每日信息流] 2024-03-30' is a machine-generated daily information-feed digest, not a request for a concrete code change to this repository. Provenance: .github/workflows/daily.yml auto-creates these issues (`gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"`), and yarb.py::update_today() writes the exact body format `# 每日安全资讯(<date>)` followed by `- <feed>` and `  - [ ] [<title>](<url>)` lines. The issue has label 'daily', author_association OWNER (Tyaoo), 0 comments, state open, and a 60,169-character body that is only a bulleted list of external Chinese security-news links with unchecked task boxes (e.g. SecWiki News, Doonsec's feed, WeChat mp.weixin.qq.com links). It contains no reproducible defect, no specific engineering feature, and no focused code-level maintenance request. The admission technical_signals (algorithm, broken, bug, bug_bounty, bypass, distributed, issue, memory) are keyword false-positives matched from linked article titles (e.g. '网络威胁指标显示24 年的情况比2023年更糟', '恶意软件上传攻击攻击 PyPI 存储库'), not descriptions of any defect in this repository. Funding is nominally live (2500 EUR, payer Tyaoo) but the deliverable is generated content, i.e. a documentation/marketing artifact rather than a code change, so per the classification rules this issue is BLOCKED.
